brief.para: Compare register with immediate and fault

authored.para: This instruction compares the value in a register with an immediate, and generates a Conditional fault exception if the comparison is true. If an exception is generated, the <reason> operand is copied to ESR_ELx.
This instruction does not affect the condition flags.

alias_list.alias_list_intro: This instruction is used by the aliases

aliasref.hover: Compare signed greater than or equal to immediate and fault
Compare unsigned higher than or same as immediate and fault
